verdict.rationale: The project ships every piece an agent needs to author a skill. There is a meta-skill, `skill-creator`, "for creating new skills and iteratively improving them", which can also benchmark them and optimize their descriptions. There is a `template/SKILL.md` and a formal Agent Skills spec covering the required frontmatter, description rules and directory layout. Packaging and distribution paths are documented through plugin manifests, `--plugin-dir` local testing, marketplaces and Skills API upload. Missing for 10: no hands-on or independent account of an agent completing the full author-to-package flow, and the evidence doesn't show `skill-creator` itself performing the packaging or upload step (only creation, improvement and benchmarking).
